chunks: You will surely have no power over My devotees: Your Lord is sufficient as their protector.
ai.seo_question: What is Satan's power over the faithful according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis as a distinct promise to the faithful, emphasizes that Satan's influence is limited to those who voluntarily follow him, whereas the true servants of God remain under His exclusive protection. It underscores the concept of divine guardianship (Wilayah) and serves as a source of spiritual confidence, affirming that God is sufficient as a protector against all external and internal forces of evil.
